# Support Channels & Assistance Guidelines

Thank you for engaging with the **Al-Birru School Information System (`albirru-sis`)**. To ensure rapid resolution of your inquiry, please review the designated support channels outlined below.

---

## 1. Prospective Parents & Admissions (PPDB)

For inquiries regarding prospective student registration, curriculum, school tours, or admissions status:

- **Admissions Portal**: [sd-albirru.sch.id/admissions](https://sd-albirru.sch.id/admissions)
- **WhatsApp Admissions Desk**: `+62 812-3456-7890` (Active Mon–Fri, 08:00–15:00 WIB)
- **Email Inquiries**: `ppdb@albirru.sch.id`
- **Campus Address**: Jl. Sukabumi - Bogor, Cicantayan, Kabupaten Sukabumi, Jawa Barat 43155

## 2. Civitas Academica & Guardian Support

For active students, parents/guardians, educators, and school administration:

- **Guardian Self-Service Portal**: [app.sd-albirru.sch.id/guardian](https://app.sd-albirru.sch.id/guardian)
- **Academic Administration Office**: `admin@albirru.sch.id`
- **Attendance & Grading Inquiries**: Contact your assigned cohort classroom teacher or school counselor via the internal portal messaging.

---

## 3. Engineering, Bug Reports & Feature Requests

If you are a developer, administrator, or contributor encountering technical anomalies within the codebase:

### 3.1 Filing a Bug Report
1. Verify if the issue has already been reported in the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Mafrilearth/albirru-school-management-monorepo/issues) tracker.
2. If unresolved, open a new issue using our structured template:
   - Provide minimal reproducible steps (MRE).
   - Include browser environment, OS, and device viewport specifications.
   - Attach console error logs or network request traces where relevant.

### 3.2 Requesting New Features
- Propose architectural enhancements or feature extensions via [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Mafrilearth/albirru-school-management-monorepo/discussions) or by opening a Feature Request issue.
- Please detail the educational rationale, target user persona (Admin, Teacher, Guardian, Student), and anticipated system impact.

---

## 4. Security Vulnerability Disclosures

**Do not file public GitHub issues for security flaws or sensitive data leaks.**

For reporting security vulnerabilities, please strictly follow the protocols defined in our [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md):
- **Private Advisory**: Submit via GitHub Security Advisory tab.
- **Security Contact**: Email `security@albirru.sch.id` with encrypted proof-of-concept details.
- **SLA**: Triage within 48 hours; critical remediation deployed within 72 hours.
